notifications.title: Agent cloud environment is missing the renderer's Python packages
notifications.detail: In today's Scout session `python -m generator.run state --format long` crashed with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'PIL'` until I ran `python -m pip install -r renderer/requirements.txt`. Scout works around it, but Studio and the video runs depend on the same command.
notifications.fix: In claude.ai/code, open this repo's cloud environment settings and add `python -m pip install -q -r renderer/requirements.txt` to its setup script (or make sure the existing setup script runs it), then start a new session and check that `python -m generator.run state` runs.
